structured_output.conclusion: No lending conclusion is reached, and the review is incomplete (Jev check quota exhausted; 18 inventory items escalated as blocking disputes). Under the Knight loan, Synergy shall not add any other debt without paying out Knight first, and a default on any third-party debt automatically defaults the Knight loan. Whether Knight has consented to a new advance is therefore the pivotal missing fact. Synergy is required to pay $2,000,000 in 2024 on the Atrium settlement loan (the Atrium link is inferred from matching amounts and cross-references) and $600,000 in 2024 on the March 27, 2024 supplier settlement loan. With about $2.0M of reported cash, $100,000 unavailable and a $200,000 illustrative reserve, the sensitivity shows required net cash of $900,000 if none of these amounts was paid since measurement, $250,000 at 25% paid, and $0 at 50% or more. The $2,235,986 Atrium settlement gain reduced 2023 cost of sales and creates no cash inflow.
